title: CompletedMatchingRingMapKernelTorsion
statement: Let A be a Noetherian commutative local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], m its maximal ideal, C its m-adic completion, U the complement of the closed point in Spec A, q:Y to U finite, s:E to Spec C finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], and D a completion overlap identification [def-sbc-punctured-completion-matching-sections]. Let P be the ring pushout of the matching ring and C over A, and let psi:P to Gamma(E) be [def-sbc-completed-matching-ring-map]. Write i:A to P for the structural map through the matching ring. For every x in P with psi(x)=0, there exists n in the natural numbers such that i(a)*x=0 for every a in m^n.

proof.text: Apply completedRingMap_kernel_local_torsion to the kernel element x to obtain a finite generating family of m and individual annihilating powers.

Give the pushout its A-algebra structure from the structural ring homomorphism. Let J be the annihilator of the cyclic submodule generated by x. Each generator lies in radical J by its individual annihilating power, hence m lies in radical J. The maximal ideal is finitely generated by Noetherianity (Ideal.fg_of_isNoetherianRing). Mathlib Ideal.exists_pow_le_of_le_radical_of_fg yields m^n <= J. Submodule.mem_annihilator_span_singleton and Algebra.smul_def translate this to the required multiplication formula. This is the fully proved private ideal_pow_mul_annihilates helper.

proof_origin.place: Tag 05ER localization argument split off; the ideal-power step proved via Mathlib radical and annihilator lemmas

lean.statement:
theorem completedRingMap_kernel_torsion
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens}
    (hU : ∀ x : Spec (.of A), x ∈ U ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {q : Y ⟶ U.toScheme} [IsFinite q]
    {E : Scheme.{u}} {s : E ⟶ Spec
      (.of (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))} [IsFinite s]
    (D : CompletionGluingData A U q E s) :
    ∀ x, D.completedRingMap x = 0 → ∃ n : ℕ,
      ∀ a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A ^ n,
        (D.baseMap ≫ pushout.inl _ _).hom a * x = 0
